name: Lifecycle hook runs a shell command
description: A command handler binds a shell command to a Codex lifecycle event. commandWindows is an optional Windows-only override of that command, reported as a finding of its own. Project-local hooks load only when the project .codex/ layer is trusted, and a non-managed hook must be reviewed and trusted through /hooks before it runs; new or changed hooks are skipped until trusted, unless Codex is started with --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust, which runs enabled hooks without persisted trust. The finding does not depend on whether that review has happened.
message: Hook runs a shell command on its lifecycle event

name: Lifecycle hook calls an MCP tool
description: An mcp_tool handler lets a lifecycle event call a tool on an already-connected MCP server, sending structured arguments directly to the tool, and it uses the same trust review as a command hook. Project-local hooks load only when the project .codex/ layer is trusted, and a non-managed hook must be reviewed and trusted through /hooks before it runs; new or changed hooks are skipped until trusted, unless Codex is started with --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust, which runs enabled hooks without persisted trust. The finding does not depend on whether that review has happened.
message: Hook calls an MCP tool on its lifecycle event
